verses.original: וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵ֨י הַמַּלְאָכִ֤ים סְדֹ֙מָה֙ בָּעֶ֔רֶב וְל֖וֹט יֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּשַֽׁעַר־ סְדֹ֑ם וַיַּרְא־ לוֹט֙ וַיָּ֣קָם לִקְרָאתָ֔ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַפַּ֖יִם אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū šə·nê ham·mal·’ā·ḵîm sə·ḏō·māh bā·‘e·reḇ wə·lō·wṭ yō·šêḇ bə·ša·‘ar- sə·ḏōm way·yar- lō·wṭ way·yā·qām liq·rā·ṯām way·yiš·ta·ḥū ’ap·pa·yim ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: Now the two angels arrived at Sodom in the evening and Lot was sitting in the gateway of the city When Lot saw them he got up to meet them bowed facedown . . .
verses.literalPt: Chegaram os dois anjos a Sodoma, à tarde, estando Ló sentado na porta de Sodoma; Ló, quando os viu, levantou-se para os receber e, prostrando-se com o rosto em terra,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר הִנֶּ֣ה נָּא־ אֲדֹנַ֗י ס֣וּרוּ נָ֠א אֶל־ בֵּ֨ית עַבְדְּכֶ֤ם וְלִ֙ינוּ֙ וְרַחֲצ֣וּ רַגְלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּ֖ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֣ם לְדַרְכְּכֶ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לֹּ֔א כִּ֥י בָרְח֖וֹב נָלִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hin·neh nā- ’ă·ḏō·nay sū·rū nā ’el- bêṯ ‘aḇ·də·ḵem wə·lî·nū wə·ra·ḥă·ṣū raḡ·lê·ḵem wə·hiš·kam·tem wa·hă·laḵ·tɛm lə·ḏar·kə·ḵem way·yō·mə·rū lō kî ḇā·rə·ḥō·wḇ nā·lîn
verses.literal: and said . . . . . . My lords please turn aside into the house of your servant wash your feet and spend the night Then you can rise early and go on your way No . . . they answered we will spend the night in the square
verses.literalPt: disse-lhes: Eis, agora, meus senhores, vinde para a casa do vosso servo, passai nela a noite, e lavai os pés, e de madrugada vos levantareis, e ireis vosso caminho. Responderam eles: Não; mas na praça passaremos a noite.

verses.original: וַיִּפְצַר־ בָּ֣ם מְאֹ֔ד וַיָּסֻ֣רוּ אֵלָ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־ בֵּית֑וֹ וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לָהֶם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וּמַצּ֥וֹת אָפָ֖ה וַיֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·ṣar- bām mə·’ōḏ way·yā·su·rū ’ê·lāw way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- bê·ṯōw way·ya·‘aś lā·hem miš·teh ū·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ’ā·p̄āh way·yō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: But Lot insisted . . . so strongly that they followed him into his house He prepared a feast for them and baked unleavened bread and they ate
verses.literalPt: Instou-os muito, e foram e entraram em casa dele; ele lhes deu um banquete, fez assar uns pães asmos, e eles comeram.

verses.original: טֶרֶם֮ יִשְׁכָּבוּ֒ וְאַנְשֵׁ֨י הָעִ֜יר אַנְשֵׁ֤י סְדֹם֙ נָסַ֣בּוּ עַל־ הַבַּ֔יִת מִנַּ֖עַר וְעַד־ זָקֵ֑ן כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם מִקָּצֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ṭe·rem yiš·kā·ḇū wə·’an·šê hā·‘îr ’an·šê sə·ḏōm nā·sab·bū ‘al- hab·ba·yiṯ min·na·‘ar wə·‘aḏ- zā·qên kāl- hā·‘ām miq·qā·ṣeh
verses.literal: Before they had gone to bed all . . . the men of the city . . . of Sodom both young and old . . . surrounded . . . the house
verses.literalPt: Porém, antes que se deitassem, cercaram a casa os homens da cidade, os homens de Sodoma, assim os moços como os velhos, sim, todo o povo, de todos os lados;

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ אֶל־ לוֹט֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔וֹ אַיֵּ֧ה הָאֲנָשִׁ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַלָּ֑יְלָה הוֹצִיאֵ֣ם אֵלֵ֔ינוּ וְנֵדְעָ֖ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·’ū ’el- lō·wṭ way·yō·mə·rū lōw ’ay·yêh hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer- bā·’ū ’ê·le·ḵā hal·lā·yə·lāh hō·w·ṣî·’êm ’ê·lê·nū wə·nê·ḏə·‘āh ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: They called out to Lot saying Where are the men who came to you tonight . . . Send them out to us so we can have relations with them
verses.literalPt: e, chamando a Ló, disseram-lhe: Onde estão os homens que entraram esta noite em tua casa? Traze-os cá fora a nós, para que os conheçamos.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֧א אֲלֵהֶ֛ם ל֖וֹט הַפֶּ֑תְחָה וְהַדֶּ֖לֶת סָגַ֥ר אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ’ă·lê·hem lō·wṭ hap·peṯ·ḥāh wə·had·de·leṯ sā·ḡar ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: Lot went outside to meet them shutting the door behind him
verses.literalPt: Então, Ló saiu-lhes à porta e fechou-a atrás de si.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אַל־ נָ֥א אַחַ֖י תָּרֵֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar ’al- nā ’a·ḥay tā·rê·‘ū
verses.literal: Please my brothers he pleaded don’t do such a wicked thing
verses.literalPt: E disse: Rogo-vos, meus irmãos, não procedais tão perversamente.

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֨א לִ֜י שְׁתֵּ֣י בָנ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יָדְעוּ֙ אִ֔ישׁ אוֹצִֽיאָה־ נָּ֤א אֶתְהֶן֙ אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ן כַּטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם רַ֠ק לָֽאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָאֵל֙ אַל־ תַּעֲשׂ֣וּ דָבָ֔ר כִּֽי־ עַל־ כֵּ֥ן בָּ֖אוּ בְּצֵ֥ל קֹרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- nā lî šə·tê ḇā·nō·wṯ ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū ’îš ’ō·w·ṣî·’āh- nā ’eṯ·hen ’ă·lê·ḵem wa·‘ă·śū lā·hen kaṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem raq lā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl ’al- ta·‘ă·śū ḏā·ḇār kî- ‘al- kên bā·’ū bə·ṣêl qō·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Look . . . I have two daughters who have never slept with a man Let me bring . . . them to you and you can do to them as you please . . . But do not do anything to these men for . . . . . . they have come under the protection of my roof
verses.literalPt: Eu tenho duas filhas que ainda não conheceram varão. Permita-me que vo-las traga para fora e fazei-lhes como bem vos parecer; somente nada façais a estes homens, porquanto entraram debaixo da sombra do meu telhado.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ׀ גֶּשׁ־ הָ֗לְאָה וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ הָאֶחָ֤ד בָּֽא־ לָגוּר֙ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֣ט שָׁפ֔וֹט עַתָּ֕ה נָרַ֥ע לְךָ֖ מֵהֶ֑ם וַיִּפְצְר֨וּ בָאִ֤ישׁ בְּלוֹט֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַֽיִּגְּשׁ֖וּ לִשְׁבֹּ֥ר הַדָּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū geš- hā·lə·’āh way·yō·mə·rū hā·’e·ḥāḏ bā- lā·ḡūr way·yiš·pōṭ šā·p̄ō·wṭ ‘at·tāh nā·ra‘ lə·ḵā mê·hem way·yip̄·ṣə·rū ḇā·’îš bə·lō·wṭ mə·’ōḏ way·yig·gə·šū liš·bōr had·dā·leṯ
verses.literal: Get out of the way . . . they replied And they declared This one came here as a foreigner and he is already acting like a judge . . . Now we will treat you worse than them And they pressed . . . in on Lot . . . and moved in to break down the door
verses.literalPt: Eles, porém, disseram: Sai daí. E acrescentaram: Esse indivíduo entrou a peregrinar e quer fazer-se juiz; agora, havemos de te tratar a ti pior do que a eles. Arremessaram-se sobre o homem, sobre Ló, e aproximaram-se para arrombar a porta.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֶת־ יָדָ֔ם וַיָּבִ֧יאוּ אֶת־ ל֛וֹט אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַבָּ֑יְתָה וְאֶת־ הַדֶּ֖לֶת סָגָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·lə·ḥū hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’eṯ- yā·ḏām way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- lō·wṭ ’ă·lê·hem hab·bā·yə·ṯāh wə·’eṯ- had·de·leṯ sā·ḡā·rū
verses.literal: But the men inside reached out . . . pulled Lot into the house with them and shut the door
verses.literalPt: Porém os homens, estendendo as mãos, fizeram entrar Ló para dentro de casa e fecharam a porta.

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֣תַח הַבַּ֗יִת הִכּוּ֙ בַּסַּנְוֵרִ֔ים מִקָּטֹ֖ן וְעַד־ גָּד֑וֹל וַיִּלְא֖וּ לִמְצֹ֥א הַפָּֽתַח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer- pe·ṯaḥ hab·ba·yiṯ hik·kū bas·san·wê·rîm miq·qā·ṭōn wə·‘aḏ- gā·ḏō·wl way·yil·’ū lim·ṣō hap·pā·ṯaḥ
verses.literal: And they struck the men at the entrance . . . young and old with blindness so that they wearied themselves trying to find the door
verses.literalPt: Feriram de cegueira os que estavam do lado de fora, tanto pequenos como grandes, de sorte que se cansaram para achar a porta.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים אֶל־ ל֗וֹט עֹ֚ד מִֽי־ לְךָ֣ פֹ֔ה חָתָן֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יךָ וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ לְךָ֖ בָּעִ֑יר הוֹצֵ֖א מִן־ הַמָּקֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’el- lō·wṭ ‘ōḏ mî- lə·ḵā p̄ōh ḥā·ṯān ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- lə·ḵā bā·‘îr hō·w·ṣê min- ham·mā·qō·wm
verses.literal: Then the two men said to Lot Do you have anyone else here a son-in-law your sons or daughters or anyone else in the city who belongs to you Get them out of here
verses.literalPt: Então, perguntaram os homens a Ló: Tens tu mais alguém aqui? Genro, e teus filhos, e tuas filhas, todos quantos tens na cidade, tira-os para fora deste lugar,

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מַשְׁחִתִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ אֶת־ הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּֽי־ גָֽדְלָ֤ה צַעֲקָתָם֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיְשַׁלְּחֵ֥נוּ יְהוָ֖ה לְשַׁחֲתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- maš·ḥi·ṯîm ’ă·naḥ·nū ’eṯ- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh kî- ḡā·ḏə·lāh ṣa·‘ă·qā·ṯām ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh way·šal·lə·ḥê·nū Yah·weh lə·ša·ḥă·ṯāh
verses.literal: because we are about to destroy this place For the outcry to . . . the LORD against its people is so great that He has sent us to destroy it
verses.literalPt: pois nós vamos destruir este lugar, porque o clamor deles se tem tornado grande diante de Jeová; e Jeová nos enviou a destruí-lo.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א ל֜וֹט וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר׀ אֶל־ חֲתָנָ֣יו׀ לֹקְחֵ֣י בְנֹתָ֗יו וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ ק֤וּמוּ צְּאוּ֙ מִן־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּֽי־ מַשְׁחִ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ הָעִ֑יר וַיְהִ֥י כִמְצַחֵ֖ק בְּעֵינֵ֥י חֲתָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê lō·wṭ way·ḏab·bêr ’el- ḥă·ṯā·nāw lō·qə·ḥê ḇə·nō·ṯāw way·yō·mer qū·mū ṣə·’ū min- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh kî- maš·ḥîṯ Yah·weh ’eṯ- hā·‘îr way·hî ḵim·ṣa·ḥêq bə·‘ê·nê ḥă·ṯā·nāw
verses.literal: So Lot went out and spoke to the sons-in-law who were pledged in marriage to his daughters Get up he said Get out of this place for the LORD is about to destroy the city But his sons-in-law thought he was joking
verses.literalPt: Tendo saído Ló, falou com seus genros, que haviam de casar com suas filhas, e disse-lhes: Levantai-vos, saí deste lugar, porque Jeová há de destruir a cidade. Mas ele pareceu aos seus genros como quem estava zombando.

verses.original: וּכְמוֹ֙ הַשַּׁ֣חַר עָלָ֔ה וַיָּאִ֥יצוּ הַמַּלְאָכִ֖ים בְּל֣וֹט לֵאמֹ֑ר קוּם֩ קַ֨ח אֶֽת־ אִשְׁתְּךָ֜ וְאֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֤י בְנֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ הַנִּמְצָאֹ֔ת פֶּן־ תִּסָּפֶ֖ה בַּעֲוֺ֥ן הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·mōw haš·ša·ḥar ‘ā·lāh way·yā·’î·ṣū ham·mal·’ā·ḵîm bə·lō·wṭ lê·mōr qūm qaḥ ’eṯ- ’iš·tə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- šə·tê ḇə·nō·ṯe·ḵā han·nim·ṣā·’ōṯ pen- tis·sā·p̄eh ba·‘ă·wōn hā·‘îr
verses.literal: At daybreak . . . the angels hurried Lot along saying Get up Take your wife and your two daughters who are here or you will be swept away in the punishment of the city
verses.literalPt: E, ao amanhecer, os anjos apertavam com Ló, dizendo: Levanta-te, toma tua mulher e tuas duas filhas que estão aqui, para que não pereças no castigo da cidade.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְמַהְמָ֓הּ׀ וַיַּחֲזִ֨קוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּיָד֣וֹ וּבְיַד־ אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ וּבְיַד֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י בְנֹתָ֔יו בְּחֶמְלַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו וַיֹּצִאֻ֥הוּ וַיַּנִּחֻ֖הוּ מִח֥וּץ לָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·mah·māh way·ya·ḥă·zi·qū hā·’ă·nā·šîm bə·yā·ḏōw ū·ḇə·yaḏ- ’iš·tōw ū·ḇə·yaḏ šə·tê ḇə·nō·ṯāw bə·ḥem·laṯ Yah·weh ‘ā·lāw way·yō·ṣi·’u·hū way·yan·ni·ḥu·hū mi·ḥūṣ lā·‘îr
verses.literal: But when Lot hesitated the men grabbed his hand and the hands of his wife and his two daughters And they led them safely out of the city because of the LORD’s compassion for them
verses.literalPt: Ele, porém, se demorava; os homens pegaram-lhe pela mão, pela mão da mulher dele e pela mão das duas filhas dele, sendo-lhe misericordioso Jeová: tiraram-no e puseram-no fora da cidade.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כְהוֹצִיאָ֨ם אֹתָ֜ם הַח֗וּצָה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִמָּלֵ֣ט עַל־ נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ אַל־ תַּבִּ֣יט אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ וְאַֽל־ תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בְּכָל־ הַכִּכָּ֑ר הָהָ֥רָה הִמָּלֵ֖ט פֶּן־ תִּסָּפֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵə·hō·w·ṣî·’ām ’ō·ṯām ha·ḥū·ṣāh way·yō·mer him·mā·lêṭ ‘al- nap̄·še·ḵā ’al- tab·bîṭ ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā wə·’al- ta·‘ă·mōḏ bə·ḵāl hak·kik·kār hā·hā·rāh him·mā·lêṭ pen- tis·sā·p̄eh
verses.literal: As soon as the men had brought them out one of them said Run for your lives Do not look back and do not stop anywhere on the plain Flee to the mountains or you will be swept away
verses.literalPt: Quando os tinham tirado para fora, disse um deles: Escapa-te, salva a tua vida; não olhes para trás de ti, nem pares em toda a planície; escapa-te para o monte, para que não pereças.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹט אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אַל־ נָ֖א אֲדֹנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lō·wṭ ’ă·lê·hem ’al- nā ’ă·ḏō·nāy
verses.literal: But Lot replied . . . No my lords please
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Ló: Não, senhor meu;

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֠א מָצָ֨א עַבְדְּךָ֣ חֵן֮ בְּעֵינֶיךָ֒ וַתַּגְדֵּ֣ל חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ עִמָּדִ֔י לְהַחֲי֖וֹת אֶת־ נַפְשִׁ֑י וְאָנֹכִ֗י לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ לְהִמָּלֵ֣ט הָהָ֔רָה פֶּן־ תִּדְבָּקַ֥נִי הָרָעָ֖ה וָמַֽתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- nā mā·ṣā ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā wat·taḡ·dêl ḥas·də·ḵā ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘im·mā·ḏî lə·ha·ḥă·yō·wṯ ’eṯ- nap̄·šî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî lō ’ū·ḵal lə·him·mā·lêṭ hā·hā·rāh pen- tiḏ·bā·qa·nî hā·rā·‘āh wā·mat·tî
verses.literal: Your servant has indeed . . . found favor in your sight and you have shown me . . . great kindness by sparing my life But I cannot . . . run to the mountains . . . the disaster will overtake me and I will die
verses.literalPt: eis que teu servo tem achado graça diante de ti, e tens engrandecido a tua misericórdia, que me mostraste, salvando-me a vida. Eu não me posso escapar ao monte para que o mal não me apanhe, e eu morra.

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֠א הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֧את קְרֹבָ֛ה לָנ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּה וְהִ֣יא מִצְעָ֑ר אִמָּלְטָ֨ה נָּ֜א שָׁ֗מָּה הֲלֹ֥א מִצְעָ֛ר הִ֖וא וּתְחִ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- nā hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ qə·rō·ḇāh lā·nūs šām·māh wə·hî miṣ·‘ār ’im·mā·lə·ṭāh nā šām·māh hă·lō miṣ·‘ār hî ū·ṯə·ḥî nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Look there is a town nearby where I can flee and it is a small place Please let me flee . . . there is it not a small place Then my life will be saved
verses.literalPt: Eis ali perto essa cidade para a qual eu posso fugir, e é pequena. Permite que eu me escape para lá (porventura, não é pequena?), e viverá a minha alma.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו הִנֵּה֙ נָשָׂ֣אתִי פָנֶ֔יךָ גַּ֖ם לַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֛י הָפְכִּ֥י אֶת־ הָעִ֖יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw hin·nêh nā·śā·ṯî p̄ā·ne·ḵā gam lad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh lə·ḇil·tî hā·p̄ə·kî ’eṯ- hā·‘îr ’ă·šer dib·bar·tā
verses.literal: Very well he answered . . . I will grant this request . . . . . . . . . as well and will not demolish the town you indicate
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe: Quanto a isto, também te hei atendido, para não subverter a cidade de que acabas de falar.

verses.original: מַהֵר֙ הִמָּלֵ֣ט שָׁ֔מָּה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת דָּבָ֔ר עַד־ בֹּאֲךָ֖ שָׁ֑מָּה עַל־ כֵּ֛ן קָרָ֥א שֵׁם־ הָעִ֖יר צֽוֹעַר׃
verses.transliteration: ma·hêr him·mā·lêṭ šām·māh kî lō ’ū·ḵal la·‘ă·śō·wṯ dā·ḇār ‘aḏ- bō·’ă·ḵā šām·māh ‘al- kên qā·rā šêm- hā·‘îr ṣō·w·‘ar
verses.literal: Hurry Run there quickly for I cannot . . . do anything until you reach it That is why . . . the town was called . . . Zoar
verses.literalPt: Apressa-te, escapa-te para lá; pois nada posso fazer antes que chegues ali. Por isso, se chamou o nome da cidade Zoar.

verses.original: הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ יָצָ֣א עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְל֖וֹט בָּ֥א צֹֽעֲרָה׃
verses.transliteration: haš·še·meš yā·ṣā ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·lō·wṭ bā ṣō·‘ă·rāh
verses.literal: And by the time the sun had risen over the land Lot had reached Zoar
verses.literalPt: Tinha saído o sol sobre a terra, quando Ló chegou a Zoar.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֗ה הִמְטִ֧יר עַל־ סְדֹ֛ם וְעַל־ עֲמֹרָ֖ה גָּפְרִ֣ית וָאֵ֑שׁ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה מִן־ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh him·ṭîr ‘al- sə·ḏōm wə·‘al- ‘ă·mō·rāh gā·p̄ə·rîṯ wā·’êš mê·’êṯ Yah·weh min- haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then the LORD rained down sulfur and fire on Sodom . . . and Gomorrah from the LORD out of the heavens
verses.literalPt: Então, Jeová fez chover sobre Sodoma e sobre Gomorra enxofre e fogo, da parte de Jeová, desde o céu;

verses.original: וַֽיַּהֲפֹךְ֙ אֶת־ הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔ל וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ הַכִּכָּ֑ר וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הֶעָרִ֔ים וְצֶ֖מַח הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·hă·p̄ōḵ ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl wə·’êṯ kāl- hak·kik·kār wə·’êṯ kāl- yō·šə·ḇê he·‘ā·rîm wə·ṣe·maḥ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: Thus He destroyed these cities and the entire plain including all the inhabitants of the cities and everything that grew on the ground
verses.literalPt: subverteu aquelas cidades, e toda a planície, e todos os moradores das cidades, e o que nascia da terra.

verses.original: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מֵאַחֲרָ֑יו וַתְּהִ֖י נְצִ֥יב מֶֽלַח׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tab·bêṭ ’iš·tōw mê·’a·ḥă·rāw wat·tə·hî nə·ṣîḇ me·laḥ
verses.literal: But Lot’s wife looked back and she became a pillar of salt
verses.literalPt: Mas a mulher de Ló olhou de detrás dele e ficou convertida em uma estátua de sal.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם בַּבֹּ֑קֶר אֶל־ הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ עָ֥מַד שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kêm ’aḇ·rā·hām bab·bō·qer ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- ‘ā·maḏ šām ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Early the next morning Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood . . . . . . before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Tendo-se levantado Abraão de madrugada, foi ao lugar onde estivera de pé diante de Jeová;

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁקֵ֗ף עַל־ פְּנֵ֤י סְדֹם֙ וַעֲמֹרָ֔ה וְעַֽל־ כָּל־ פְּנֵ֖י אֶ֣רֶץ הַכִּכָּ֑ר וַיַּ֗רְא וְהִנֵּ֤ה עָלָה֙ קִיטֹ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ כְּקִיטֹ֖ר הַכִּבְשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·qêp̄ ‘al- pə·nê sə·ḏōm wa·‘ă·mō·rāh wə·‘al- kāl- pə·nê ’e·reṣ hak·kik·kār way·yar wə·hin·nêh ‘ā·lāh qî·ṭōr hā·’ā·reṣ kə·qî·ṭōr hak·kiḇ·šān
verses.literal: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah . . . and all . . . the land of the plain and he saw . . . the smoke rising from the land like smoke from a furnace
verses.literalPt: e, contemplando Sodoma e Gomorra e toda a terra da planície, viu, e eis que o fumo da terra subia como o fumo duma fornalha.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּשַׁחֵ֤ת אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ עָרֵ֣י הַכִּכָּ֔ר וַיִּזְכֹּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיְשַׁלַּ֤ח אֶת־ לוֹט֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַהֲפֵכָ֔ה בַּהֲפֹךְ֙ אֶת־ הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ יָשַׁ֥ב בָּהֵ֖ן לֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·ša·ḥêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- ‘ā·rê hak·kik·kār way·yiz·kōr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām way·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- lō·wṭ mit·tō·wḵ ha·hă·p̄ê·ḵāh ba·hă·p̄ōḵ ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer- yā·šaḇ bā·hên lō·wṭ
verses.literal: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain He remembered Abraham and He brought Lot out of the catastrophe that destroyed the cities where he had lived . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando Deus destruiu as cidades da planície, então, se lembrou de Abraão e tirou a Ló do meio da destruição, quando subverteu as cidades em que Ló habitara.

verses.original: וַיַּעַל֩ ל֨וֹט מִצּ֜וֹעַר וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב בָּהָ֗ר וּשְׁתֵּ֤י בְנֹתָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י יָרֵ֖א לָשֶׁ֣בֶת בְּצ֑וֹעַר וַיֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בַּמְּעָרָ֔ה ה֖וּא וּשְׁתֵּ֥י בְנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al lō·wṭ miṣ·ṣō·w·‘ar way·yê·šeḇ bā·hār ū·šə·tê ḇə·nō·ṯāw ‘im·mōw kî yā·rê lā·še·ḇeṯ bə·ṣō·w·‘ar way·yê·šeḇ bam·mə·‘ā·rāh hū ū·šə·tê ḇə·nō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains for he was afraid to stay in Zoar where they . . . . . . lived in a cave
verses.literalPt: Subiu Ló de Zoar e habitou no monte, ele e suas duas filhas, porque teve medo de ficar em Zoar; e habitou numa caverna, ele e suas duas filhas.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֧אמֶר הַבְּכִירָ֛ה אֶל־ הַצְּעִירָ֖ה אָבִ֣ינוּ זָקֵ֑ן וְאִ֨ישׁ אֵ֤ין בָּאָ֙רֶץ֙ לָב֣וֹא עָלֵ֔ינוּ כְּדֶ֖רֶךְ כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hab·bə·ḵî·rāh ’el- haṣ·ṣə·‘î·rāh ’ā·ḇî·nū zā·qên wə·’îš ’ên bā·’ā·reṣ lā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lê·nū kə·ḏe·reḵ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: One day the older daughter said to the younger Our father is old and there is no man in the land to sleep with us as is the custom over all the earth
verses.literalPt: Disse a primogênita à menor: Nosso pai é velho, e na terra não há homem que venha unir-se conosco, como é o costume de toda a terra.

verses.original: לְכָ֨ה נַשְׁקֶ֧ה אֶת־ אָבִ֛ינוּ יַ֖יִן וְנִשְׁכְּבָ֣ה עִמּ֑וֹ וּנְחַיֶּ֥ה מֵאָבִ֖ינוּ זָֽרַע׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵāh naš·qeh ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·nū ya·yin wə·niš·kə·ḇāh ‘im·mōw ū·nə·ḥay·yeh mê·’ā·ḇî·nū zā·ra‘
verses.literal: Come let us get our father drunk with wine so we can sleep with him and preserve his line
verses.literalPt: Vinde, façamos que nosso pai beba vinho e vamos deitar-nos com ele, para que possamos conservar a linhagem de nosso pai.

verses.original: וַתַּשְׁקֶ֧יןָ אֶת־ אֲבִיהֶ֛ן יַ֖יִן בַּלַּ֣יְלָה ה֑וּא וַתָּבֹ֤א הַבְּכִירָה֙ וַתִּשְׁכַּ֣ב אֶת־ אָבִ֔יהָ וְלֹֽא־ יָדַ֥ע בְּשִׁכְבָ֖הּ וּבְקׄוּמָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·taš·qe·nā ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·hen ya·yin bal·lay·lāh hū wat·tā·ḇō hab·bə·ḵî·rāh wat·tiš·kaḇ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·hā wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘ bə·šiḵ·ḇāh ū·ḇə·qū·må̄h
verses.literal: So that night they got their father drunk with wine and the firstborn went in and slept with her father he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up
verses.literalPt: Aquela noite, pois, deram de beber vinho a seu pai, e, entrando a primogênita, deitou-se com ele; ele não sentiu, nem quando ela se deitou, nem quando se levantou.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַתֹּ֤אמֶר הַבְּכִירָה֙ אֶל־ הַצְּעִירָ֔ה הֵן־ שָׁכַ֥בְתִּי אֶ֖מֶשׁ אֶת־ אָבִ֑י נַשְׁקֶ֨נּוּ יַ֜יִן גַּם־ הַלַּ֗יְלָה וּבֹ֙אִי֙ שִׁכְבִ֣י עִמּ֔וֹ וּנְחַיֶּ֥ה מֵאָבִ֖ינוּ זָֽרַע׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ wat·tō·mer hab·bə·ḵî·rāh ’el- haṣ·ṣə·‘î·rāh hên- šā·ḵaḇ·tî ’e·meš ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî naš·qen·nū ya·yin gam- hal·lay·lāh ū·ḇō·’î šiḵ·ḇî ‘im·mōw ū·nə·ḥay·yeh mê·’ā·ḇî·nū zā·ra‘
verses.literal: The next day the older daughter said to the younger Look I slept with my father last night Let us get him drunk with wine again tonight so you can go in and sleep with him and we can preserve our father’s line
verses.literalPt: No dia seguinte, disse a primogênita à menor: Eis que ontem à noite me deitei com meu pai. Demos-lhe de beber vinho esta noite também; entra e deita-te com ele, para que possamos conservar a linhagem de nosso pai.

verses.original: וַתַּשְׁקֶ֜יןָ גַּ֣ם בַּלַּ֧יְלָה הַה֛וּא אֶת־ אֲבִיהֶ֖ן יָ֑יִן וַתָּ֤קָם הַצְּעִירָה֙ וַתִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עִמּ֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־ יָדַ֥ע בְּשִׁכְבָ֖הּ וּבְקֻמָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·taš·qe·nā gam bal·lay·lāh ha·hū ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·hen yā·yin wat·tā·qām haṣ·ṣə·‘î·rāh wat·tiš·kaḇ ‘im·mōw wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘ bə·šiḵ·ḇāh ū·ḇə·qu·māh
verses.literal: So again that night they got their father drunk with wine and the younger daughter went in and slept with him he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up
verses.literalPt: Tornaram, pois, aquela noite a dar de beber vinho a seu pai, e, levantando-se a menor, deitou-se com ele; ele não sentiu, nem quando ela se deitou, nem quando se levantou.

verses.original: וַֽתַּהֲרֶ֛יןָ שְׁתֵּ֥י בְנֽוֹת־ ל֖וֹט מֵאֲבִיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·hă·re·nā šə·tê ḇə·nō·wṯ- lō·wṭ mê·’ă·ḇî·hen
verses.literal: Thus both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father
verses.literalPt: Assim, as duas filhas de Ló conceberam de seu pai.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֤לֶד הַבְּכִירָה֙ בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ מוֹאָ֑ב ה֥וּא אֲבִֽי־ מוֹאָ֖ב עַד־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ hab·bə·ḵî·rāh bên wat·tiq·rā šə·mōw mō·w·’āḇ hū ’ă·ḇî- mō·w·’āḇ ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: The older daughter gave birth to a son and named him . . . Moab He is the father of the Moabites of today
verses.literalPt: A primogênita deu à luz um filho e chamou-lhe Moabe: este é o pai dos moabitas, até o dia de hoje.

verses.original: וְהַצְּעִירָ֤ה גַם־ הִוא֙ יָ֣לְדָה בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֶּן־ עַמִּ֑י ה֛וּא אֲבִ֥י בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֖וֹן עַד־ הַיּֽוֹם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·haṣ·ṣə·‘î·rāh ḡam- hî yā·lə·ḏāh bên wat·tiq·rā šə·mōw ben- ‘am·mî hū ’ă·ḇî ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: The younger daughter also gave birth to a son and she named him Ben-ammi . . . He is the father of the Ammonites . . . of today
verses.literalPt: A menor também deu à luz um filho e chamou-lhe Ben-Ami: este é o pai dos filhos de Amom, até o dia de hoje.
